## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.20

- **Extensions install more reliably**: the app now tells Android the real name of the extension it is installing, read from the downloaded file, instead of the name written in the extension list. When the two did not match, an installation could look unfinished. Fix from Animetail.
- **Safer anime library after an update**: after an update the app repairs a few parts of the anime database by itself. It now waits for that repair to finish and reports any error, instead of carrying on while it is still running. Fix from Animetail.
- **Filters in the anime library search**: searches such as `src:"Source name"` and `lang:en` now work in the anime library too, as they already did for manga. Tapping the source name on an anime's page opens the library with only the anime from that source. Fix from Animetail.
- **"Updates failed" keeps only what is still true**: titles you moved to another source or removed from the library no longer stay on the list, and a title marked "extension not installed" leaves it once the extension is there. The list is cleaned when you open it and after every update. Automatic anime updates also wait for the extensions to load first: when the update was what started the app, the first titles could be reported as "extension not installed" with the extension installed.
- **"Updates failed" is easier to reach**: it is now always in Settings › Library, under the switch for its notification, and says how many titles failed (in red) or that none did. While titles failed to update, it is also in the ⋮ menu of Updates, with their number in a gold pill.
